raw_output:
Giver: Hi, I'm giving you directions to get from Start to Finish.
Follower: Okay, I'm ready. Where do we start?
Giver: Start is right here. Turn left, go about two inches.
Follower: Left two inches... okay.
Giver: Go down a bit past the sandstone cliffs on the left.
Follower: Got it, passing the cliffs.
Giver: Now go down towards the forge, but don't go right next to it.
Follower: Okay, I'm going down... and then I'm turning right.
Giver: Wait, the old pine is on the right. Turn right to go around it.
Follower: Ah, right of the pine. Okay, I see the pine forest now on my left.
Giver: Good. Keep going down the forest stream, don't cross it.
Follower: Okay, I'm following the stream... wait, there's no stream here.
Giver: Don't worry about the stream, just keep going down towards the bakery.
Follower: Okay, heading for the bakery.
Giver: Pass the bakery on your right.
Follower: Done.
Giver: Now go up towards the canal.
Follower: Up to the canal... okay, I'm passing it on the right.
Giver: Now turn left towards the crane bay.
Follower: Left towards the bay.
Giver: Go down to the bay.
Follower: Okay, at the bay now.
Giver: Turn right, head back down towards the wheatfields.
Follower: Right, down to the wheatfields.
Giver: Go down, but stop before you hit the rocket warehouse.
Follower: Okay... I see the warehouse.
Giver: Pass it on the left.
Follower: Wait, the warehouse is on my right.
Giver: What? Pass it on the left. Go back up a bit.
Follower: Oh, I'm going back up. Okay, left of the warehouse.
Giver: Good. Now head down towards the old lighthouse.
Follower: Down to the lighthouse.
Giver: Go left of the lighthouse.
Follower: Left of the lighthouse. Okay.
Giver: Turn left, go down past the cave.
Follower: Wait, there's a cave on the left here?
Giver: Yeah, go down past the cave.
Follower: Okay, going down... wait, I'm lost. Which way to Finish?
Giver: Finish is down near the bottom, left of the lighthouse.
Follower: Okay, I see the lighthouse at the bottom.
Giver: Go left from the lighthouse to Finish.
Follower: Okay, heading there now. Got it!
